issues.description: The template declares singFarmSongVerse without an Animal parameter (the parameter is commented out), whereas both the problem statement and the solution expect singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This signature mismatch in the template will confuse students and prevent them from implementing or testing the helper with the expected parameter.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template method signature to match the intended design: declare singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). Optionally align visibility with the problem statement (make it public if tests rely on that), or modify the problem text to reflect the intended visibility. Ensuring the parameter is present resolves the immediate implementation barrier.
